## Overview

`deseq2reports` is a modular RNA-seq differential expression pipeline built on
DESeq2. You can run **everything in one call**, or call **each stage on its
own** and assemble the HTML report at the end.

Modules cover quality control, sample distance/PCA, differential expression,
GSEA, optional WGCNA, CollecTRI/ULM TF activity, VIPER (bcellViper), STRING
PPI connectivity, and a multi-page self-contained HTML report.

For a detailed, code-focused explanation of what each module does (inputs,
outputs, and key arguments), see the companion vignette
**[Module reference](deseq2reports-modules.html)**
(`vignette("deseq2reports-modules", package = "deseq2reports")`).

Organism (human/mouse) is auto-detected from gene symbols via
`detect_organism()` -- there is no `org` argument. Row names should be
standard HGNC/MGI symbols (not Ensembl/Entrez IDs).

## One-command pipeline

```{r}
library(deseq2reports)
library(DESeq2)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~condition
)

out <- run_deseq2_pipeline(
  dds = dds,
  var = "condition",
  filter_method = "cpm",
  cpm_percentile = 0.05,
  shrinkage = "ashr",
  ranking = "pxfc",
  collections = c("HALLMARK", "GOBP", "REACTOME"),
  run_wgcna = TRUE,
  run_decoupler = TRUE,
  run_viper = TRUE,
  run_ppi = TRUE,
  render_html = TRUE,
  save_dir = "results"
)
```

Under `results/` this writes per-module folders plus `index.html`:

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `qc/` | Filtering summaries, library QC plots, `qc.html` |
| `distance/` | PCA / similarity artifacts (shown on the QC page) |
| `deseq2/` | Per-contrast DE tables & plots, `deseq2.html` (+ PPI when enabled) |
| `clusterprofiler/` | Per-contrast GSEA, `clusterprofiler.html` |
| `wgcna/` | Modules, ORA, `wgcna.html` (if `run_wgcna = TRUE`) |
| `decoupler/` | CollecTRI/ULM, `decoupler.html` (if `run_decoupler = TRUE`) |
| `viper/` | bcellViper/VIPER, `viper.html` (if `run_viper = TRUE`) |
| `ppi/` | STRING PPI CSVs/PDFs (embedded in DE/WGCNA pages when `run_ppi = TRUE`) |
| `logs/` | Timestamped run log + JSON session record |

`out` is a list with `dds`, `distance`, `diffexp`, `gsea`, optional
`wgcna` / `decoupler` / `viper` / `ppi`, and `report_path` (named HTML paths).

## Modular usage

Each stage is a standalone function with the same arguments the pipeline uses.
Typical workflow:

```{r}
library(deseq2reports)
library(DESeq2)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~condition)

# 1. QC / filtering
dds_qc <- run_qc(
  dds, var = "condition",
  filter_method = "cpm", cpm_percentile = 0.05,
  save_dir = "results/qc"
)

# 2. Sample similarity / PCA
distance_out <- run_distance_pca(
  dds_qc, var = "condition",
  save_dir = "results/distance"
)

# 3. Differential expression (all pairwise + one-vs-rest by default)
diffexp_out <- run_diffexp_pipeline(
  dds_qc, var = "condition",
  shrinkage = "ashr", ranking = "pxfc",
  save_dir = "results/deseq2"
)

# 4. GSEA
gsea_out <- run_gsea_pipeline(
  diffexp_out$results,
  collections = c("HALLMARK", "GOBP", "REACTOME"),
  ranking = "pxfc",
  save_dir = "results/clusterprofiler"
)

# 5. Optional modules
wgcna_out <- run_wgcna_pipeline(dds_qc, var = "condition", save_dir = "results/wgcna")
decoupler_out <- run_decoupler_pipeline(
  dds_qc, var = "condition", diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  save_dir = "results/decoupler"
)
viper_out <- run_viper_pipeline(
  dds_qc, var = "condition", diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  save_dir = "results/viper"
)
ppi_out <- run_ppi_pipeline(
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out, wgcna_out = wgcna_out,
  save_dir = "results/ppi"
)

# 6. HTML report
render_report(
  dds = dds_qc,
  var = "condition",
  distance_out = distance_out,
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  gsea_out = gsea_out,
  wgcna_out = wgcna_out,
  decoupler_out = decoupler_out,
  viper_out = viper_out,
  ppi_out = ppi_out,
  save_dir = "results"
)
```

You can stop after any stage, inspect CSVs/PDFs, tweak arguments, and continue.
Omit optional outputs (`wgcna_out = NULL`, etc.) and those report pages are
greyed out in the navigation bar rather than removed.

## Two-factor designs

Pass two grouping columns to build interaction contrasts automatically:

```{r}
out <- run_deseq2_pipeline(
  dds,
  var = c("Tissue", "Isotype"),
  save_dir = "results_2factor"
)
```

Or set `design = ~ Tissue * Isotype` (and optional `batch`) yourself via
`design` / `resolve_design()`.

## Reading the HTML report

Open `results/index.html`. Every section page is self-contained
(`self_contained = TRUE`) with relative cross-links, so the folder tree can be
copied offline. Each report section shows the **minimal package call** needed
to reproduce that module's results.
